prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1212; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.

Q: Understood. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving south on the main road in Pearland, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down near the light.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I had come to a complete stop behind a car at the light. I was waiting for it to turn green when I felt the hit from behind.

Q: How fast do you think the other vehicle was moving?

A: It didn't look like it was going very fast, but it hit me hard enough that my head snapped back and then forward. My car jolted and I could hear the bumper crack.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?

A: I got out for a minute, but my neck was already stiff and my lower back was aching. I sat down on the curb until the police came.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and a lower back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. Turning my head to check my blind spot is hard, and I can't sit for long periods without my back hurting. Some days are better than others.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I was stopped and wasn't doing anything wrong. I just want my car repaired and my medical bills taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
